exercises.audioText: Many people underestimate how much stress affects the immune system. Chronic stress can increase inflammation and make the body more vulnerable to illness. Simple habits, like regular exercise and consistent sleep schedules, can significantly reduce this risk. Today we will look at a few techniques you can start using this week.
